[[Gulf Coast Showcase]] champions |bowl= [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = First Round }} {{2015–16 Big Sky men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Weber State Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Weber State University]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Wildcats were led by tenth-year head coach [[Randy Rahe]] and played their home games at the [[Dee Events Center]] in [[Ogden, Utah]]. They were members of the [[Big Sky Conference]]. The Wilsdcats finished the season 26–9, 15–3 in Big Sky play to win the regular season championship. They defeated [[2015–16 Portland State Vikings men's basketball team|Portland State]], [[2015–16 North Dakota Fighting Hawks men's basketball team|North Dakota]], and [[2015–16 Montana Grizzlies basketball team|Montana]] in the [[2016 Big Sky Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Sky tournament]]. to earn the conference's automatic bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As a No. 15 seed in the NCAA Tournament, they lost to [[2015–16 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the first round. ==Previous season== The [[2014–15 Weber State Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]] 13–17, 8–10 in Big Sky play to finish in a tie for seventh place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2015 Big Sky Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Sky tournament]] to [[2014–15 Montana Grizzlies basketball team|Montana]]. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
